purpose: E2E, one full real-test pass per configuration, not original PyTorch repeated GPU-only protocol
timing_boundary: time.perf_counter_ns immediately before reading/CPU preprocessing through after GPU H2D/forward/D2H + CPU softmax/argmax
gpu_only_timing: CUDA events around model(x), separately recorded
preprocessing: PIL RGB, Resize(256 shorter edge, BILINEAR), CenterCrop(224), float32 /255, ImageNet normalization
dtype: FP32/FP16 model parameters and input on GPU; preprocessed input float32 on host
batch_pad: repeat last valid image to B; exclude padded predictions from accuracy
result_scope: E2E includes on-demand image read and preprocessing, host/device transfer, GPU compute, CPU prediction; excludes checkpoint loading, warmup and CSV writing
